name: agent-builder-model-map-reconciliation
body:
Reconciliation (spec-writer, `agent-builder-model-map` change-set; [autonomous] unless noted). SOURCE: SPEC.md (`md.SPEC.md.agent-builder-model-map-spec`) — teach the `agent-builder` template to maintain the repo's `opencode.json` agent→model map and to ask for preferred model mappings; reconcile the agent-builder main-write carve-outs so `opencode.json` is an allowed surface; `codebase-navigator` gets no model mapping.

VERIFIED against the branch graph: `opencode.json` is a graphed File node (`File {fqn:'opencode.json'}`, lines 1-22) carrying the `json.opencode.json.$schema` and `json.opencode.json.agent` Structs; it holds per-agent `agent.<name>.model` entries (agent-builder, the reviewers/writers, the implementer family) and NO `codebase-navigator` entry. The only code surface this change-set edits is `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` (File node; the sole `implemented-by` target of `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt`). `AGENTS.md`, `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` and `opencode.json` itself are NOT edited by this change-set.

DECISION — second write path, SAME carve-out. `opencode.json` is documented as part of the agent-builder's EXISTING main-write carve-out (carve-out 1 of `global.constraint.worktree-isolation`), not a new third carve-out: the law still counts exactly TWO agent carve-outs, and carve-out 1 now covers `.opencode/agents/**` AND `opencode.json`.

Amended in place (edge-preserving `apg_node update`):
- `global.constraint.worktree-isolation` — carve-out 1 now names `.opencode/agents/**` AND the `opencode.json` agent→model map.
- `requirements.constraint.agent-changes-always-on-main` — the agent-builder's main-write grants are `.opencode/agents/**` AND `opencode.json`; its on-main commits cover both.
- `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-main-flow` — step 3 and the write-grant/clarification prose now include `opencode.json`.
- `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt` — new surface point (d): it instructs the agent-builder to create/update `opencode.json`, interview for `agent.<name>.model` preferences over the generated AND distributed suite agents, merge non-destructively, and exclude `codebase-navigator`.
- `domain.entity.agent-scaffold-flow` and `domain.entity.main-integration` — the on-main write surface now names `.opencode/agents/**` AND `opencode.json` (stale after the carve-out amendment).

Added:
- `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-model-map` (feature `agent-builder-model-map`) — the interview step, the non-destructive write/merge, and the `codebase-navigator` exclusion. Parented under `requirements.user.navigator-agent` (the actor that dispatches the agent-builder; the sibling `agent-builder-main-flow` lives there) rather than the roster stakeholder.
- `requirements.constraint.agent-builder-model-map-scope` (`attaches-to` the requirement) — the law form.
- `domain.entity.agent-model-map` — the model-mapping concept, spanning the generated set AND the distributed suite agents (so `domain.entity.generated-agent-set` was the wrong home).

SPINE. `requirements.user.navigator-agent ⊃ requirements.requirement.agent-builder-model-map —drives→ domain.entity.agent-model-map —realised-by→ solution.component.agent-builder-prompt —implemented-by→ opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`. The new entity is realised-by the EXISTING narrow component (whose sole `implemented-by` target is the one edited file), so coverage maps 1:1 to `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md` and pulls in no untouched code — deliberately NOT driving `domain.entity.agent-scaffold-flow`, whose other realised-by components (`solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt` → `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`, `solution.component.repo-agent-guide` → `AGENTS.md`) are NOT edited here.

PLAN CONSEQUENCE (for the plan-writer). Satisfy the NEW requirement `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-model-map`; do NOT declare `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-main-flow` satisfied — it is reconciled as an existing carve-out, and satisfying it would demand plan tasks over `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` and `AGENTS.md`, neither of which this change-set edits (`rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.coverage_check` derives solution coverage from satisfied requirements' spine).

NON-GOALS / follow-ups. `AGENTS.md` and `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` are not touched (this change-set's Scope is the one template file). `AGENTS.md`'s own step-7 prose still says the agent-builder's sole write surface is `.opencode/agents/**`; that guide update is a follow-up, deliberately outside this change-set, so it is not reflected in `solution.component.worktree-isolation-guide` (anchored to `AGENTS.md`) either. `codebase-navigator` is confirmed absent from the model map and must stay absent.
